summaries.Romania: Romania's new government under Luca Niculescu was sworn in after a 5-month political crisis, facing immediate budget deficits and energy challenges. Key institutional positions shifted with new ministers appointed across foreign affairs, justice, defense and education amid concerns about PSD dominance.
summaries.Healthcare: Healthcare innovation focus spans rare disease drug manufacturing, vaccine confidence strategies, and AI-assisted clinical tools, while nursing home quality oversight and mental health provider directories emerge as critical patient safety issues.
summaries.Tech: Apple's iPhone Duo launched to mixed reviews as a messily ambitious first-gen foldable, while critical PHP vulnerabilities, AI safety concerns, and infrastructure security issues dominated tech security discourse this week.

items.title: Luca Niculescu, după prima ședință de Guvern: „În aproape șase luni de criză politică s-au adunat multe urgențe”
items.snippet: Guvernul condus de Luca Niculescu a primit votul de încredere al Parlamentului și a depus jurământul, marți seară, la Palatul Cotroceni, iar la scurt timp a avut prima ședință la Palatul Victoria. items.line: New Romanian government assumes power after half-year crisis, setting immediate priorities for budget deficit reduction and energy security amid concerning power concentration in PSD.

items.title: STAT+: Mark Cuban wants to crack open the market for rare disease treatments
items.snippet: Mark Cuban's Cost Plus Drugs says it can reduce manufacturing costs for custom rare disease drugs and n-of-1 gene therapies.
items.line: Mark Cuban's Cost Plus Drugs targets rare disease drug manufacturing to reduce costs, potentially disrupting pricing for ultra-expensive custom therapies.

items.snippet:

items.title: A counterintuitive way to build trust in measles vaccines and public health
items.snippet: Some experts say public health messaging would be more credible if it focused less on measles deaths and acknowledged that most children survive.
items.line: Public health experts recommend acknowledging vaccine survival rates rather than emphasizing deaths to build measles vaccine confidence.

items.snippet: The iPhone Duo is the riskiest Apple product in years. items.title: Anthropic’s cloud partnerships are getting messy
